module.purpose: Defines the team profile settings route, generating localized metadata and rendering the legacy team profile view within the shared settings shell.
module.summary: This route adapter connects the application-router settings path to an existing team profile implementation. It resolves localized profile labels and descriptions, builds route-aware metadata using the team identifier, and places the legacy view inside the standard settings header component.
module.businessContext: Supports team administrators viewing and managing a team's profile settings. Failure prevents the team profile page and its localized metadata from rendering.
functions: generateMetadata (~L6-13): Builds localized metadata for the team profile route
Page (~L15-27): Renders the team profile inside settings navigation chrome

units.name: generateMetadata
units.source:
export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
  await _generateMetadata(
    (t) => t("profile"),
    (t) => t("profile_team_description"),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    `/settings/teams/${(await params).id}/profile`
  );
